text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Oh heck, look at the time! I've gotta head to training right awa—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: There are sooo many cute clothes here!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Every piece just screams me—perfect for a cute Umadol style! ☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Like this long frilly skirt… and this oversized knit dress…

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: And this reversible blouse looks like it would go great with plenty of outfits!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: They're all so pretty! My heart is just leaping!

text_block_list.name: Shop Staff
text_block_list.text: Hello! Feel free to try anything on!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, all right! ☆ Now, let's see… Which one should I try on first? ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: …And that's how Smart Falcon completely forgets about training.
